name: Shinshin Hotel Cheonjiyeon
detail: This is a great accommodation for the price. I am satisfied with the economical management. The facilities are clean, and the bed is comfortable. The location is good, as it is close to the Olle Market. I had a good week staying here. Thank you.

name: Hotel Leo
detail: The location is very close to the Lotte Duty-Free Shop, which is very convenient for families with children. There is also a park with a slide suitable for preschoolers nearby (Samsam Park), making it perfect for dads to take the kids to the park while moms shop at the duty-free store~ 😂 There are also many bus routes near the hotel, making it very convenient. The rooms are relatively large and quite clean.

name: Nonday Laboratory
detail: The environment here is really nice, and the location is very convenient; it's only 50 meters to the East Gate Market and the bus station. The mattress and pillows are made of silicone, which makes for a very comfortable sleep. The staff, including the older sisters and brothers, are all super nice! They are very responsive to requests. Breakfast is served until eleven o'clock, and it includes simple milk, cereal, toast, and jam. Everyone is very polite and quiet. The microwave and refrigerator are all available, creating wonderful memories ❤️ I will come back next time~~

name: LOTTE CITY HOTEL JEJU AIRPORT
detail: The room condition was good, and the bedding was soft. The location was in the city center, making transportation convenient, and guests could take a free bus to the airport. The staff at the room maid service, pool, and lobby desk were very friendly. If you go in the summer, I recommend going to the pool around sunset to evening because the sunlight is strong during the day. I recommend only requesting the hotel breakfast on the morning of check-out. The view is nice, but the taste is not great. It might be better not to request it unless you have a busy morning where you can't stop by other places on your way to the airport.

name: Gwandeok Stay
detail: The guesthouse is located in a great spot, very close to Jeju Airport. There are many convenience stores nearby, and Dongmun Market Night Market, Qixing Road, and Dongmun Underground Market are all within walking distance, making transportation very convenient. It only takes about 3-4 minutes to walk to the Gwandukjeong bus station. The staff is very friendly and patiently answers and resolves any questions or issues. Luggage can also be stored in the café on the first floor, which offers some simple Korean meals and coffee. There are also convenience stores in the vicinity, making it very convenient. This time I traveled alone and booked a single room; the room is very spacious, clean, and tidy, with good sound insulation. It’s very quiet at night, no noise, and the pillows and mattress are soft, allowing for a comfortable sleep. There are also some public areas available for use, which is very convenient. Next time I visit Jeju Island, I will stay here again! I recommend everyone to stay here, hehe~

name: Co-op City Hotel Seongsan
detail: The location is really good, with Seongsan Ilchulbong and Udo Ferry Terminal just a 5-minute drive away. (It's also possible to walk!) Although the room size isn't very large, it was well-maintained and the heating was warm, making for a comfortable stay. Above all, it was quiet without noise, which allowed for a good night's sleep, and that was satisfying. The breakfast felt more focused on quality than variety, but it was excellent in quality for a reasonable price. Thanks to the friendly service from the staff, I was able to start my trip in a good mood.

name: Index Jdream Hotel Jeju
detail: The front desk offers 24-hour service and was very attentive; our check-in at dawn went smoothly without any delays. The hotel's location is also quite good; in addition to being on Health Road, there are three convenience stores within a minute's walk, which is very convenient, and the nearby three-no park is also quite interesting. As for the disadvantages: first, there is no full-length mirror; aside from using the reflection of the front door from the hallway as a makeshift dressing mirror, it can be a hassle to confirm today's outfit; second, the lighting in the bathroom is somewhat confusing; it seems to be on a timer? Be careful while showering, as you may need a companion to help turn the lights back on.

name: Shinshin Hotel Seogwipo
detail: A hotel that costs around 90,000 won for a 2-night, 3-day weekend is an incredible value. The bathroom was clean, and I preferred the wooden floor over carpet. The view from the hotel room wasn't great, but the location is excellent, being less than a ten-minute walk to Olle Market and a five-minute walk to Lee Jung Seop Street. The surrounding shops were well-established, and parking was convenient, so I highly recommend it.

name: Mangrove Jeju City
detail: I was debating where to book accommodation for a short trip to Jeju, which was just for one night and two days. I ended up making a reservation based on a friend's recommendation. The location near the airport allowed me to enjoy my short schedule fully. It was my first time using automated check-in/check-out, and it was more convenient than I expected! I was very satisfied with the room condition for the price. The room was spacious, and the remodeling was done cleanly. The refrigerator was larger than those in typical hotels, and having a desk, sofa, and coffee table was fantastic! If I had to point out a downside, it would be the lack of a TV, but since I don’t watch TV much while traveling, it wasn’t an issue for me at all. I was pleasantly surprised by the free breakfast, which had a good variety. Having a simple breakfast of cereal, eggs, fruit, and coffee filled me up nicely for the day. There was a convenience store nearby, the Dongmun Market was within walking distance, and the seaside walking path was close, so I stayed very satisfied. I plan to recommend this place to acquaintances who are visiting Jeju next!

name: Linden Guest house
detail: The location is good as it is easily accessible to downtown Jeju City, Yeondong, Tapdong, Dongmun Restaurant, and the airport. The accommodation price-performance ratio is excellent. Therefore, you can adapt to the amenities accordingly, but there were no discomforts when it came to sleeping. Parking is a bit difficult. That is a downside, but we are very satisfied as we stayed for two nights with plans to travel by bike. There are no towels.
